title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: new model choice in Agent definition.
summary: Business Central 28.1 introduces GPT-5.3-chat as the default AI model for Agents and Managed AI service, with a new UI switcher and AL methods allowing administrators to select between available models or use Auto mode. The post discusses model selection guidance and suggests Microsoft consider supporting GPT-5.5-chat for improved accuracy and hallucination reduction.
key_points: GPT-5.3-chat is now the default model for Agents and Managed AI service in version 28.1, with a new model switcher on the Agents page
Available AI models can be selected via UI or programmatically through new Agent codeunit methods: SetModelId, SetModelIdToAuto, GetModelId, and GetModelName
GPT-5.3-chat suits conversational and brainstorming tasks, while GPT-4.1-latest is better for complex data parsing and heavy workloads with large reference documentation
GPT-5.5-chat is recommended as a future option due to 52.5% fewer hallucinations and faster response times compared to GPT-5.3-chat

quotes.text: The new switcher permits you to choose the model that the agent will uses to complete tasks.

quotes.text: You should use GPT-5.3-chat for every task that requires conversation, brainstorming and tasks where you want a natural human-like interaction.
